name: blender
description: Create game assets in Blender and export GLB files into the project.

interface.shortDescription: Make game assets and export project-ready GLB files.
interface.longDescription: Use a local Blender installation to create or refine game assets, preserve editable blend sources, export GLB, and validate the result in the target project. Includes a collection-aware export helper. Blender is required; this workflow uses its command line and Python API.
defaultPrompt: Create a low-poly game prop in Blender and export it as GLB into this project.
Prepare this Blender asset for the project and verify its GLB export.
